Train search and reservation-workflow demonstration

Technology: Java, XML Android Views, SQLite, and the existing Node.js backend.

Live data: station search and scheduled timetable information through the RailReserve backend.

Demo features: local sample train search, reservations, PNR lookup, and cancellation.

Limitations: live fares and seat availability are unavailable on the current provider plan. The app does not issue real railway tickets, process payments, or provide live running status.
